user.title: HA-BEMS
user.description: Create missing shared inputs, import existing forecast entities, or add a flexible-device management module. Inputs can be reused by multiple modules.

entity_creator.title: BEMS entity creator
entity_creator.description: Create entities you don't already have in Home Assistant. Modules can also use existing entities.

thermal_storage.title: Thermal storage management — coming soon
thermal_storage.description: Planned: local feed-forward MILP for domestic hot water and building heating, using tunable energy demand, electricity prices, PV availability and a simple COP. Domestic hot water runs first; heating respects its reserved heat-pump windows. No indoor-temperature feedback or historical model training is planned for this first thermal approach. Submit to return to the main menu.

soc.title: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold
soc.description: Create a reusable seasonal SOC threshold. Choose editable monthly values or an existing percentage entity. This threshold can be selected by battery modules.

monthly.title: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold
monthly.description:
January to December. Default values are editable suggestions based on Central European solar irradiation conditions. At or below this threshold, HA-BEMS plans to leave the battery in standard operation. For FBC, the planned charging limit equals the configured maximum charging power. Your Home Assistant automations apply the plan.

Electricity consumption varies unpredictably, and forecasts inevitably contain errors. This threshold acts as a safeguard: it reduces the flexibility available to HA-BEMS while lowering the risk of undesirable battery operation.

existing_entity.title: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold
existing_entity.description: Select an available sensor, number or input_number containing the active threshold from 0 to 100 with unit %. Its calendar logic stays with that entity. No automatic fallback is used if it becomes unavailable.

load_profile.title: Non-flexible load profile
load_profile.description: Estimate the non-flexible behind-the-meter building demand at 15-minute resolution. Enter annual consumption excluding separately modelled flexible heat pumps, EVs and battery losses. Choose H0, H25 or a constant profile. H25 contains some average PV self-consumption influence. Country and region select the holiday calendar; leave region empty for national holidays. All fields can be changed later.

data.name: Entity group name
data.holiday_subdivision: Holiday region (optional; e.g. AT: 1 for Burgenland, DE: BY for Bavaria)

fbc.title: Electrical storage management — FBC
fbc.description: FBC (Forecast based charging) provides operating plans and recommendations. Use your own Home Assistant automations to apply these results to your battery system.

data.name: Virtual device
data.soc_entity: Select actual battery SOC in % used by the FBC algorithm
data.seasonal_soc_entity: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold entity

data_description.name: Name of the virtual Battery control strategy device; this does not rename your physical battery.
data_description.soc_entity: Select the measured battery state of charge, with unit % and a value from 0 to 100.
data_description.seasonal_soc_entity: If you don't already have this entity, create it using HA-BEMS: BEMS entity creator → Battery seasonal SOC min threshold.

fbc_battery.title: Battery parameters
fbc_battery.description: Capacity must use the same SOC basis as the selected battery sensor. The efficiency is one constant factor converting forecast PV energy into stored battery energy (for example 0.95). Include the combined conversion and charging losses once. At or below the seasonal minimum SOC, the complete FBC plan allows maximum charging power. The device output cap must be at least this maximum.

data_description.charge_efficiency: Factor from 0 to 1: 0.95 means that 95% of forecast PV energy becomes stored battery energy. A constant factor cannot recover PV peaks already clipped in the forecast.
data_description.output_limit_w: Set this to the physical output limit. It must not be lower than maximum charging power; equal values are normally appropriate.

fbc_forecast.title: Select shared PV generation forecast
fbc_forecast.description:
Select a PV input registered under BEMS entity importer. Register your prepared forecast helper there first, then return to FBC setup. Format, full next-72-hour coverage and source freshness are checked before continuing. Source selection and age settings belong to the importer and can be changed there for all consuming modules.

{reason}

entity_importer.title: BEMS entity importer
entity_importer.description: Register existing forecast entities as shared inputs. HA-BEMS tests their format, coverage and source age, and exposes an input status. Modules reuse the same validated input.

menu_options.future_imports: Electricity prices and additional forecasts — coming soon

future_imports.title: Additional forecast inputs — coming soon
future_imports.description: Planned input types: electricity import prices, electricity export prices and further forecasts needed by future modules. Each type will have a documented unit and value format. Price inputs are not implemented in this version. Submit to return to the importer menu.

import_pv.title: Import PV generation forecast
import_pv.description:
Select one forecast sensor prepared in Home Assistant. Its state must be nonnegative power in W. Required attributes: schema_version: 1, source_updated_at (original source update time with timezone), and forecast (ordered list of start, end and power_w records). Each record must contain a timezone-aware start/end and the interval-average power in W for exactly 15 minutes. Include the current quarter-hour and at least the next 72 hours without gaps, including explicit nighttime zeros. Never replace missing data with zero. A rolling helper normally needs 289 intervals. HA-BEMS tests the format, coverage and source age before registering this input for reuse by modules. The original forecast remains on your source entity; the importer adds a status sensor without duplicating the forecast. [Helper design and example]({helper_docs_url}).

{reason}

data_description.forecast_entity: Use a prepared helper such as sensor.pv_generation_forecast_72h. Provider sensors must first be converted to the documented shared format.
data_description.forecast_max_age_minutes: Checked against source_updated_at, not the time the helper was regenerated.

import_preview.title: PV input test passed

error.invalid_entity: Choose an available numeric percentage entity from 0 to 100 with unit %.
error.self_reference: Choose an external entity; this entry cannot use its own output as its input.
error.invalid_load_profile: Check the annual consumption and the holiday country/region combination.
error.invalid_forecast: Forecast test failed. Correct the imported input or its source using the detailed message below; setup cannot continue until the test passes.
error.output_limit_below_maximum: The output cap must be at least the maximum charging power. Review both values.
error.no_pv_import: No PV input is registered yet. Add HA-BEMS again, choose BEMS entity importer → PV generation forecast, and complete its test before setting up FBC.
